name: my2sql Binlog Toolkit
description: MySQL binlog viewer, SQL/rollback generator and flashback executor for DBX.

contributions.label: my2sql MySQL Source
contributions.description: A MySQL instance whose binlog can be read. The replication user needs SELECT, REPLICATION SLAVE and REPLICATION CLIENT.

fields.label: Fake replica server-id
fields.description: Must not clash with any real replica on the source server.

fields.label: Binlog timezone (-tl)
fields.description: Used to interpret datetime columns and the start/stop time range.

fields.label: TLS
fields.description: Encrypt the MySQL session for metadata queries and the binlog dump. SSH/SOCKS tunnels are provided by DBX itself: the plugin always dials the endpoint after DBX transport layers.

contributions.label: my2sql
contributions.description: Parse MySQL binlog online (as a fake replica) or offline (local files); generate original SQL, rollback SQL or DML/big-transaction stats, then execute the rollback against a target connection.

zh-CN.name: my2sql Binlog 工具
zh-CN.description: MySQL binlog 查看、SQL/回滚生成与闪回执行工具。

io.github.my2sql.source.label: my2sql MySQL 源
io.github.my2sql.source.description: 可读取 binlog 的 MySQL 实例。复制账号需要 SELECT、REPLICATION SLAVE、REPLICATION CLIENT 权限。

username.label: 复制账号
username.description: 需要 REPLICATION SLAVE / REPLICATION CLIENT 权限

timezone.label: binlog 时区 (-tl)
timezone.description: 用于解释 datetime 列与起止时间

tls.label: TLS
tls.description: 加密元数据查询与 binlog dump 会话。SSH/SOCKS 隧道由 DBX 本身提供，插件始终拨向隧道转换后的端点。

options.verify: 加密并校验证书（仅直连 TCP）

io.github.my2sql.main.label: my2sql
io.github.my2sql.main.description: 在线（伪装从库）或离线（本地文件）解析 MySQL binlog，生成原始 SQL、回滚 SQL 或 DML/大事务统计，并可对目标连接执行回滚。
